Interface EffectivePermissions

All Known Implementing Classes:
EffectivePermissionsJson
public interface EffectivePermissions
The effective (resolved) permissions for a principal within a project and service, as returned by the IAM effective-permissions operation.

This is a read-only response view (spec schema EffectivePermissions).
